blockingLoop.evidence: Repeated 'Unplug the machine... unscrew the pump filter... check condenser' across four turns, with the customer still unable to proceed

rationale: The assistant correctly noted early that a 9kg load against 6kg dry capacity can leave clothes damp and that the heater works because the clothes are hot. After the customer reported turning spin down to 800 and that a half drum dries fully, it never concluded overloading plus low spin was the cause, and instead kept sending them to the filter and condenser. It also repeated the same filter and condenser steps across several turns and asserted a user-accessible condenser behind the flap on this model without evidence, which is likely inaccurate. This left the customer stuck, though no part was pushed and nothing was unsafe.
